name: flowcast
description: Root build entry so a host can build this repo. web/ imports from ../theme and ../map-client, so it cannot be built with its own folder as the Root Directory. Build uses `cd`, not `npm --prefix`: with no package argument, --prefix run from this directory installs THIS package into the target and writes a circular "flowcast": "file:.." dependency into web and map-client.

scripts.build: cd map-client && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../web && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
